settings.heading: Why are O-Tropin® and Orenda Immune + Detox® bundled together?
settings.row_content: These two products have been among Orenda's most reordered formulas for more than two decades, and the reason they work well together goes beyond convenience. O-Tropin® supports the neuroendocrine communication pathway that governs how the body responds to stress and recovers overnight. Orenda Immune + Detox® supports immune coordination at the cellular level and the liver's daily detoxification pathway. Chronic stress suppresses detoxification and compromises immune function. O-Tropin® addresses the conditions that create that burden, while Orenda Immune + Detox® addresses the burden itself. They work on the same system from two different and complementary entry points.*

settings.heading: How do I take the Awaken Bundle?
settings.row_content:
Orenda Immune + Detox® is taken as two capsules daily, with or without food.

O-Tropin® is taken as an oral spray. Shake well before use. Spray two full sprays in the mouth in the morning and four full sprays in the evening. Hold in the mouth for 30 seconds before swallowing, and take 30 minutes before or after eating to ensure a clean palate.

O-Tropin® is not recommended for pregnant or nursing women, persons with active cancer, diabetic retinopathy, or acromegaly, or persons taking prescription medications without first consulting a healthcare provider. As always, consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement routine.

settings.heading: Is the Awaken Bundle suitable for both men and women?
settings.row_content: Yes — both O-Tropin® and Orenda Immune + Detox® are formulated for men and women. The pituitary gland, immune system, and liver's detoxification pathways are central to well-being across both sexes, and the ingredients in both formulas support these systems regardless of gender. Adults navigating midlife hormonal shifts, both men and women, may find particular relevance in the combined support these two formulas provide.*

settings.heading: How does liposomal delivery work and why does it matter for Orenda O-Tropin®?
settings.row_content:
For certain nutrients to deliver their intended benefits, they need to survive the journey through the digestive system, stomach acid, digestive enzymes, and the complex intestinal environment, which can degrade sensitive compounds before they reach the bloodstream. Liposomal delivery was developed specifically to address this challenge for formulas where ingredient stability and absorption matter most.

Each key nutrient in O-Tropin is encapsulated within a liposome, a tiny sphere made of phospholipids, the same healthy fats that form the membranes of every cell in the human body. This protective layer helps ingredients remain stable as they move through the body and supports their absorption into the bloodstream.* Because liposomes share their structure with cell membranes, the body recognizes and absorbs them readily.*

Orenda uses sunflower-sourced phospholipids specifically, a clean, plant-derived source that is non-GMO, soy-free, gluten-free, and dairy-free, and carries Generally Recognized as Safe status. Many phospholipid sources are soy-derived, making the soy-free distinction meaningful for anyone mindful of soy in their supplement routine. It is a deliberate formulation choice that reflects Orenda's commitment to a cleaner, more inclusive formula.

O-Tropin takes this further with its oral spray format. Rather than being swallowed immediately, O-Tropin is held in the mouth for 30 seconds before swallowing, allowing nutrients to begin absorbing directly through the mucous membranes of the mouth before they reach the digestive system.* This supports a more direct delivery pathway than capsules, tablets, or standard liquid supplements can provide, and is the specific advantage of the O-Tropin oral spray format within the broader liposomal delivery story.

Orenda has used this liposomal delivery system in O-Tropin for over 20 years, one of the longest-standing applications of liposomal technology in the natural health supplement space. The delivery system is what makes this purposeful formula work as intended.*

settings.heading: What is calcium d-glucarate, and why is it in Orenda Immune + Detox®?
settings.row_content:
Calcium d-glucarate supports glucuronidation — the liver's primary detoxification pathway. Glucuronidation works by binding toxins and excess hormones to glucuronic acid, making them water-soluble so the body can clear them through normal elimination. It's one of the most important and most overlooked detoxification processes the body runs every day.

The reason supplementing with calcium d-glucarate matters is what happens without adequate support. An enzyme produced by certain gut bacteria, called beta-glucuronidase, can interfere with glucuronidation, essentially splitting the bond between processed toxins and the compounds that carry them out of the body. When that happens, those toxins are reabsorbed into circulation rather than eliminated, creating a recycling loop that adds to the body's overall toxic burden over time.

Calcium d-glucarate helps inhibit beta-glucuronidase activity, keeping that recycling loop from running and supporting more complete toxin clearance.* It also supports healthy hormone metabolism, helping the body clear excess estrogen and environmental estrogen mimickers that accumulate through diet, environment, and natural hormonal shifts.* This is particularly relevant for adults navigating midlife hormonal changes, when the body's natural detox channels are under greater demand.*

Research also suggests that calcium d-glucarate supports a balanced inflammatory response, an important consideration given the close connection between immune function and inflammation.* When the body's detoxification pathways are working well, the immune system is better positioned to respond appropriately rather than remaining in a state of ongoing activation.*

This is why detoxification belongs in an immune formula. A body managing a high toxic burden is an immune system already working overtime, and calcium d-glucarate addresses that burden directly, every day.*

settings.heading: What are the benefits of PharmaGABA® in Orenda O-Tropin®?
settings.row_content:
GABA — gamma-aminobutyric acid — is one of the body's primary inhibitory neurotransmitters, meaning it plays a central role in calming nervous system activity and supporting the transition from wakefulness to rest.* The body produces GABA naturally, but production can be influenced by age, stress, and lifestyle factors, making it an increasingly relevant area of nutritional support for adults over 35.

PharmaGABA® is the branded, naturally sourced form of GABA produced through a natural fermentation process. This distinction matters because not all GABA supplements are created equal. Standard synthetic GABA supplements have inconsistent absorption profiles, while PharmaGABA®, produced through fermentation rather than chemical synthesis, is a form the body more readily recognizes and utilizes.* According to research conducted by the laboratory that developed it, PharmaGABA® is 20% more effective than standard GABA at supporting restorative sleep when experiencing occasional sleeplessness.*

In O-Tropin, PharmaGABA® serves two primary functions. First, it supports relaxation and calm nervous system activity,* contributing to the overall stress and recovery support the formula is designed to provide. Second, and most centrally to O-Tropin's benefit story, it supports restorative sleep during occasional sleeplessness.* Quality sleep is not simply a comfort benefit; it is essential to the body's natural overnight recovery and regulatory processes, including those the pituitary gland supports.*

PharmaGABA® contains no artificial ingredients or fillers and is produced without synthetic chemicals, consistent with Orenda's commitment to clean, purposeful formulation. It is one of the more credible and well-researched branded sleep-support ingredients available, and a key reason O-Tropin consistently stands apart in the healthy aging and pituitary support category.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Alpha GPC in Orenda O-Tropin®?
settings.row_content:
Alpha GPC — glycerophosphocholine — is one of the most bioavailable and well-researched forms of choline available in nutritional supplements. Choline is an essential nutrient that plays a foundational role in neurological function, neurotransmitter production, and overall brain health.* While the body produces some choline naturally, research consistently shows that many adults, particularly those over 35, do not maintain optimal choline levels through diet and natural production alone.

Alpha GPC is specifically valued because of how effectively it supports choline availability in the body.* It supports the production of acetylcholine, one of the brain's primary neurotransmitters, involved in memory, learning, attention, and overall cognitive performance.* This is why Alpha GPC has become one of the most researched ingredients in the cognitive support space and why it is increasingly recognized by healthcare providers working with adults focused on brain health and healthy aging.

In Orenda O-Tropin®, Alpha GPC contributes to the formula's broader goal of supporting cognitive function, mental clarity, and neurological well-being.* These benefits become increasingly relevant as the body ages and natural choline production declines, making Alpha GPC one of the more purposefully placed ingredients in the O-Tropin formula.

Alpha GPC also plays a specific role in supporting pituitary function,* which is central to what O-Tropin is designed to do. It works alongside the amino acid blend and Mucuna Pruriens to support the body's natural regulatory systems* contributing to the formula's integrated approach to pituitary support, restorative sleep, and healthy aging.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Mucuna Pruriens Extract in Orenda O-Tropin®?
settings.row_content:
Mucuna Pruriens is a botanical with a long history of use in traditional Ayurvedic wellness systems, with origins in the tropical regions of Africa and Asia. It has been studied and used for centuries, and its growing presence in modern nutritional research reflects what traditional practitioners recognized long before clinical science caught up.

The primary reason Mucuna Pruriens is included in O-Tropin is its natural concentration of L-DOPA, a direct precursor to dopamine, one of the body's most important neurotransmitters. Dopamine plays a central role in mood regulation, motivation, cognitive function, and neurological health.* By providing a natural source of L-DOPA, Mucuna Pruriens supports the body's own dopamine production rather than introducing synthetic compounds.*

Research supports Mucuna Pruriens for several specific benefit areas relevant to the O-Tropin formula. It supports healthy mood and motivation,* contributes to cognitive function and mental clarity,* and has been traditionally used to support the body's natural stress response.* Research also suggests it supports restorative sleep when experiencing occasional sleeplessness*, which is why it works alongside PharmaGABA® on the sleep side of the O-Tropin formula.

Mucuna Pruriens also supports the body's natural hormonal processes,* contributing to the pituitary support story that O-Tropin is built around. It is one of the most purposefully placed ingredients in the formula, working simultaneously on mood, sleep, cognitive function, and pituitary support in a way that few single botanical ingredients can.*

For adults over 35 experiencing energy, sleep, and cognitive changes that often accompany the natural aging process, Mucuna Pruriens is a well-researched and credible addition to a daily healthy-aging formula.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Moomiyo Extract (Shilajit) in Orenda O-Tropin®?
settings.row_content:
Moomiyo — more widely known today as Shilajit — is a mineral-rich adaptogenic extract with origins in the high-altitude mountain ranges of Central Asia. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic wellness systems for centuries, valued for its naturally occurring concentration of humic acids, fulvic acid, and trace minerals that are rarely found together in a single botanical source. What traditional practitioners recognized centuries ago, modern research is increasingly validating, making Shilajit one of the most studied adaptogens in the current landscape of nutritional supplements.

Orenda has included Moomiyo in the O-Tropin formula for over 20 years, long before Shilajit became one of the fastest-growing ingredients in the modern supplement space. That 20-year track record reflects both Orenda's confidence in the ingredient and the consistency of the results reported by practitioners and customers over time. Orenda was not following a trend with Moomiyo. The trend caught up with Orenda.

Research supports Shilajit for several benefit areas that are directly relevant to the O-Tropin formula. It supports the body's natural stress response,* contributes to natural energy and physical vitality,* and supports healthy aging processes over time.* As an adaptogen, Shilajit works by supporting the body's natural resilience rather than producing an immediate stimulant effect, which is consistent with how O-Tropin approaches pituitary and healthy aging support overall.*

The fulvic acid content in Shilajit is particularly relevant from a bioavailability perspective. Fulvic acid supports the body's ability to transport and absorb minerals and other nutrients at the cellular level,* which complements O-Tropin's liposomal delivery system and reinforces the formula's broader focus on absorption and bioavailability.

For adults over 35 navigating the energy, stress, and vitality changes that often accompany the natural aging process, Moomiyo Extract is a well-researched and credible addition to a daily healthy aging formula, and one of the ingredients that gives O-Tropin its depth and heritage.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of the amino acid blend in Orenda O-Tropin®?
settings.row_content:
Amino acids are the fundamental building blocks of proteins and play essential roles in virtually every biological process in the human body, from neurotransmitter production and hormone regulation to energy metabolism and tissue repair. The amino acid blend in O-Tropin was not assembled from a generic list. It was formulated specifically to support normal pituitary function,* with each amino acid chosen for a distinct and purposeful role in that story.

The blend includes eight amino acids — Ornithine Alpha Ketoglutarate, L-Glutamine, L-Arginine, L-Lysine, L-Valine, L-Isoleucine, L-Tyrosine, and Glycine. Ornithine Alpha Ketoglutarate supports energy metabolism and the body's natural recovery processes.* L-Arginine and L-Lysine work synergistically to support the body's natural regulatory processes.* L-Tyrosine supports healthy neurotransmitter production and contributes to mental clarity and focus.* Glycine supports pituitary function directly* and contributes to the restorative sleep story alongside PharmaGABA® and Mucuna Pruriens. The branched-chain amino acids, L-Valine and L-Isoleucine, support healthy muscle function and physical recovery.* L-Glutamine supports overall metabolic function and the body's natural resilience.*

What distinguishes the amino acid blend in O-Tropin from other amino acid formulas on the market is the approach. Rather than delivering large amounts of any single amino acid to force a physiological response, O-Tropin uses a precise combination that works with the body's natural regulatory systems rather than overriding them.* This philosophy, supporting the body's own processes rather than substituting for them, is central to how the entire O-Tropin formula was designed and has been refined over more than 20 years.

For adults over 35 experiencing the energy, cognitive, and vitality changes that often accompany the natural aging process, this amino acid combination represents one of the most purposeful and considered aspects of the O-Tropin formula.

settings.heading: What does organic beta-1,3 glucan do, and why is it in this formula?
settings.row_content:
Beta-1,3 glucan from organic oat bran is a soluble fiber that interacts with immune cell receptors throughout the body, specifically on macrophages, neutrophils, and natural killer cells, supporting the immune system's natural, everyday defense function.* These are the frontline cells of the innate immune response, and beta-1,3 glucan is one of the most well-studied ingredients for supporting their activity.*

Gut health and immune health are more closely connected than most people realize. Roughly 70% of the immune system resides in the gut, which is why it matters that beta-1,3 glucan also functions as a prebiotic fiber nourishing the beneficial bacteria in the digestive system that the immune system depends on.* Supporting the gut microbiome is supporting immune health from the inside out.*

Beta-1,3 glucan from oat bran has also been studied for its role in supporting healthy cholesterol levels already within the normal range and contributing to cardiovascular well-being*, a benefit backed by decades of published research. Sourced from organic oat bran rather than mushrooms, it's clean, non-GMO, and naturally gluten-free.

settings.heading: Are Oat Bran Beta 1,3 Glucans gluten-free?
settings.row_content:
Oats are naturally free of gluten, though cross-contamination during processing is a real concern with many oat-based products. That's why every batch of Orenda Immune+Detox® is tested to confirm it meets the FDA standard of less than 20 parts per million of gluten, so you can feel confident in what you're taking, every time.

The organic oat bran used in this formula is also non-GMO and suitable for both vegetarian and vegan lifestyles.

As always, if you have celiac disease or significant gluten sensitivity, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any oat-based product to your routine.

settings.heading: Benefits of Muramyl Peptides
settings.row_content:
Let’s introduce you to Muramyl Peptides, extraordinary elements extracted from lactobacillus fermentum. They’re like our body's tiny special forces soldiers that activate a broad defense against bacteria, fungi, viruses, and other minute intruders. Essentially, think of them as your body's very own security system, enhancing your immune system's readiness to protect and defend.*

What's fascinating is how they work. Your immune system recognizes Muramyl peptides as signals of bacterial presence, sparking an invigorated immune response. The key players here are macrophages, vital cells in your immune system that get a wake-up call to fight off potential infections. Once activated, these macrophages increase the production of certain compounds and support an inflammatory response, both of which are crucial in warding off infections.*

Plus, Muramyl Peptides play an important role in maintaining a balance between two types of immune response, TH1 and TH2. This balance is critical for a healthy immune system. So, while TH1 process is busy fighting off bacteria and viruses, the TH2 function is on guard against allergies and autoimmune diseases. Muramyl Peptides provide a bit of support to the TH1 defense system, supporting a well-rounded immune response.*

To put it simply, Muramyl Peptides are a little-known, but mighty ingredient that adds a extra layer of defense to your overall health and well-being.* They're like your body's own personal bouncers, always ready to ensure everything runs smoothly.

settings.heading: How Liposomal Delivery Works and Why it Matters for Your Supplements
settings.row_content:
Before a supplement can do anything useful, it has to survive the journey through your digestive system, stomach acid, digestive enzymes, and a complex intestinal environment that can degrade nutrients before they ever reach the bloodstream. Traditional supplements can lose a meaningful portion of their potency in that process.

Liposomal delivery addresses this directly.

Each key nutrient is enclosed within a liposome, a tiny sphere made from phospholipids, the same healthy fats found in your cell membranes. This protective layer helps ingredients remain stable as they move through the body and supports their absorption from the moment of ingestion. Orenda uses sunflower-based phospholipids specifically, a clean, plant-derived source that is non-GMO, soy-free, gluten-free, and dairy-free, and carries Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) status. Many phospholipid sources are soy-derived, making the soy-free distinction worth noting for anyone mindful of soy in their supplement routine. It's a deliberate choice that reflects Orenda's commitment to a cleaner, more inclusive formula.

Where conventional supplements are exposed to the digestive process from the moment they're swallowed, liposomal nutrients travel in a form designed to hold up, so more of what you're taking has the opportunity to be absorbed and used.

settings.heading: Why does Orenda use HPMC Capsules?
settings.row_content:
If you've ever looked at a supplement label and wondered what the capsule itself is made of, that's exactly the right question to ask. The capsule matters more than most people realize.

Orenda uses HPMC capsules, made from hypromellose — a plant-based material derived from wood pulp cellulose. Unlike traditional gelatin capsules, which are made from animal collagen, HPMC capsules are 100% plant-based and suitable for vegetarian and vegan lifestyles.

They also protect what's inside more effectively. HPMC has a naturally low moisture content, which helps shield sensitive ingredients from humidity and heat, keeping the formula stable from production to the moment you open the bottle. No additives, no preservatives, nothing that doesn't need to be there.

Sourced from a renewable plant material, this formulation detail reflects the same care and attention that goes into every ingredient in this formula.

settings.heading: Benefits of methylated folate as 5-MTHF
settings.row_content:
You know how sometimes, the small tweaks make all the difference? That's the story with our superstar ingredient - methylated folate.
It's all about absorbing goodness more effectively so you can optimize your wellness journey.

See, for about one-third of us, converting regular folic acid into its active, usable form is like climbing a steep hill. That's where methylated folate as 5-MTHF comes in!

We use methylated folate as 5 MTHF; it's ready for action right out of the gate because it’s already in its active form. It doesn't have to go through the conversion process. Think of it as having a VIP pass at a concert – it gets to bypass the long line (the conversion process) and go straight into the venue (your body's metabolic pathways). This means you'll get to enjoy the benefits of this vital nutrient more efficiently.

Including 5-MTHF in our product line is one of the many ways we're committed to giving you the very best. It's just another way we're committed to delivering the best to you. After all, why settle for good when you can have the best Why not add this standout nutrient to your wellness routine and experience the difference it can make!
